items.name: Amazon Bedrock
items.what: Managed access to Claude, Nova, Llama, OpenAI and other models inside your AWS account.
items.why: Default model layer for PHI workloads; application inference profiles give per-LOB cost tracking.

items.name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.what: Runtime, Gateway (MCP), Identity, Memory, Policy (Cedar), Evaluations, Observability and Agent Registry.
items.why: Managed backbone for production agents; Policy and Evaluations are GA.

items.name: Amazon Connect Customer
items.what: Agentic self-service on voice and chat, speech-to-speech voice agents, Lex, Contact Lens.
items.why: Natural host for contact-center GenAI; the former Amazon Connect, renamed April 2026.

items.name: Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base
items.what: Managed RAG: connectors, hybrid search, reranking, agentic retriever; AgentCore Gateway target.
items.why: Removes most RAG plumbing; GA June 2026.

items.name: Bedrock Guardrails
items.what: PII filters, denied topics, prompt-attack detection, contextual grounding.
items.why: Baseline input and output checks on every call.

items.name: MCP (2026-07-28 spec)
items.what: Standard interface between agents and tools; now stateless with hardened authorization.
items.why: Every system of record becomes a reusable, governed tool.

items.name: Strands Agents
items.what: AWS open-source, model-driven agent SDK for Python and TypeScript.

items.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions
items.what: Vendor-neutral trace schema for model, tool, retrieval and agent spans.
items.why: Portable traces; still Development status, so pin the version you emit.

items.name: Cedar / AgentCore Policy
items.what: Fine-grained authorization rules evaluated outside the model.
items.why: Enforces which agent may call which tool for whom; prompt injection cannot switch it off.

items.name: LangGraph
items.what: Graph-based orchestration with explicit state, checkpoints and human-in-the-loop interrupts.
items.why: When you need explicit control flow; runs on AgentCore Runtime.

items.name: Automated Reasoning checks
items.what: Formal verification of answers against written policies (Bedrock Guardrails).
items.why: Fits benefit and eligibility rules; does not stop prompt injection.

items.name: Agentic CX designer (NLX)
items.what: No-code canvas blending agentic and deterministic self-service in Connect Customer.
items.why: Could speed LOB self-service builds; in preview.

items.name: Presidio
items.what: Open-source PII detection and masking with custom recognizers.
items.why: Pre-LLM masking with member ID, NPI and claim-number recognizers.

items.name: Langfuse / Arize Phoenix
items.what: Trace exploration, prompt versions, datasets and LLM-judge evals.

items.name: Garak / PyRIT / AgentDojo
items.what: Automated red-team suites for LLMs and agents.

items.name: A2A v1.0
items.what: Agent-to-agent discovery and calls; v1.0 March 2026, now under the Agentic AI Foundation.
items.why: Only needed when agents from different teams or vendors must collaborate.

items.name: Strands Harness SDK
items.what: Ready-made open-source agent harness that runs on any cloud.

items.name: Self-hosted LiteLLM without hardening
items.what: Open-source AI gateway compromised on PyPI in March and October 2026.
items.why: If used, pin by hash, private mirror, isolated account. Prefer Bedrock-native controls.

items.name: Stateful MCP servers (pre-2026-07-28)
items.what: Session-based MCP servers built on the older spec.
items.why: Build new servers on the stateless spec; Roots, Sampling and Logging are deprecated.
